introduction: Parimarshaneeyam Indriyam Adhyaya mainly deals with the moribund symptoms based on palpating various regions of the body. It follows Pushpitakam Indriyam Adhyaya that deals with the prognosis based on observing the changes in the odour or taste in the body. The reason for this sequence can be understood as the changes in the odor or taste can be felt easily and from far whereas to palpate the patient is a must. The chapter also precedes Indriyaneekam Indriyam Adhyaya, which deals with the prognosis based on observing the functioning of the sensory organs of the body.
